item.title: Version 1.0.23
item.description:
feat: API base override for staging / local-dev builds

FlippedAPI.base is now resolved via:
  1. Launch arg --api-base=<url>
  2. Env var FLIPPED_API_BASE
  3. UserDefaults key flipped.apiBaseOverride (set from Settings)
  4. Production default

Production users always hit prod (none of #1-3 set).  This unlocks:
  - Dev builds talking to a future staging Railway service
  - Pete pointing his test phone at staging while customers use prod
  - Local FastAPI development without rebuilding the Mac app

The Settings toggle that writes to flipped.apiBaseOverride lands in
a follow-up commit (visible only in dev builds, gated behind a
DEBUG #if).
